0022600103.text: The 1-0 Portland Trail Blazers, who lead the Northwest and the West, visit the 0-1 Sacramento Kings in the second game of the season for the Trail Blazers, with both teams having played one game so far. Portland is without Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery), and Branden Carlson (concussion) and Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (out, ruptured Achilles), Dylan Cardwell (out, calf strain), and Maxime Raynaud (out, dislocated knee), while Malik Monk is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision.
